macros.name: Romanbar
macros.doc: \Romanbar{...} then produces a Roman number with bars (please see the example file).

macros.name: romannum
macros.doc: \romannum{...} turns an Arabic number into a lowercase Roman one, and \Romannum{...} turns an Arabic number into an uppercase Roman one.
